result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a command that does exactly what `updateLandscape` does, with the same options. `mvn -q -o -pl cli test` passes. I didn't run either command against a real analysis root, so the `config.json` and `index.html` output isn't checked.

- **`Commands.java`:**
  - I added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape`, using the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** the dispatch sends both names to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed, so `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` still works as the previous name.

Nothing is committed.
